title: Compiled medium-02 confirmation checkpoint still collapses after repaired attestation, invoice, and entitlement predecessors
symptom: After Prompts 15 through 17 repaired attestation, invoice, and entitlement, the original medium-02 confirmation artifact still shows SP_ConfirmAttestedRelease as an argless stdcall export with zero parameter coverage and sentinel failure -7104.
smallest_reproducer: sessions/design_suite/compiled_ingest/spectrum_transaction_release_settlement_suite/medium-02/20260411-125905/runs/08-settlement_reconcile/session/invocables_map.json shows the collapsed confirmation surface. The likely owner seam is tests/fixtures/spectrum_transaction_release_settlement_suite/settlement_validator_contract_overlay/truth_manifest.json because the same DLL already uses that overlay for SP_VerifyReservedRelease.
trust_impact: A broader medium-02 rerun is not trustworthy until the last remaining checkpoint stops collapsing at discovery time. Treating confirmation as business-logic failure before repairing the contract/spec surface would spend proving budget on a likely inherited false blocker.
allowed_next_actions: inspect only the original confirmation artifact and the settlement overlay owner seam
patch only the existing settlement overlay manifest justified by source and rerun evidence
rerun only the targeted confirmation checkpoint with repaired attestation, invoice, and entitlement predecessors
disallowed_next_actions: spend a broader medium-02 rerun before confirmation is locally trustworthy
invent a parallel overlay surface for the same DLL when the existing settlement overlay owns the contract repair mechanism
jump to hard-01 or hard-02 before medium-02 is honestly reclosed
exit_criteria: The confirmation checkpoint is narrowed to the settlement overlay owner seam, a targeted confirmation proof surface is executed, and the branch can decide from evidence whether one broader medium-02 rerun is now honest.
resolution_note: Prompt 18 first repaired the existing settlement overlay so SP_ConfirmAttestedRelease turned semantically green, then repaired a narrower S-04 synthesis coverage omission that made the first rerun invalid. The second targeted rerun under sessions/design_suite/compiled_ingest/spectrum_transaction_release_settlement_suite/medium-02/confirmation-final-remaining-checkpoint/20260411-141009 returned SP_ConfirmAttestedRelease = verified_success with valid_run = true.
